extension.summary: Cinematic screensaver: full-screen key art with title logo and genres
Cinematische screensaver: schermvullend filmbeeld met titellogo en genres
extension.description: Slowly zooming key art of trending films and series (TMDB) or your own library, with the title logo and genres bottom left. Fits the Lucent skin.
Langzaam inzoomend beeld van populaire films en series (TMDB) of je eigen bibliotheek, met links onderin het titellogo en de genres. Past bij de Lucent-skin.
extension.news: 1.2.4: The question after waking up comes again after OK on every remote; only Back skips it. 1.2.3: Uses Lucent's own TMDb key when you did not enter your own. 1.2.2: The question "Continue watching?" after the screensaver only comes when you wake it with OK, not with Back. 1.2.1: A long plot now scrolls slowly by itself, so you can read all of it. 1.2.0: Cinema style with plot and score; Continue watching with a progress bar; new episodes of your shows (today and tomorrow); a big clock with the weather; night mode (darker from an hour you choose, then black); after waking up it asks whether you want to watch what was on screen. 1.1.5: The screensaver no longer closes on its own while Kodi still has it on (it left the first button press doing nothing on Home). 1.1.4: Maker shown as Wilfried van der Voort. 1.1.3: My Trakt watchlist uses the Trakt login of the skin (Skin settings > Follow > Trakt login); no more look-ups of an add-on that is not installed. 1.1.2: New, sharper icon (indigo, with stars). 1.1.0: new choice My Trakt watchlist: your watchlist films and series, with the year and where you can watch them (Netflix, Videoland, ...). 1.0.1: slow zoom and drift of the picture (Netflix style). 1.0.0: first version.
